pages.text: Tin Ore is the primary source of Tin in TechCraft. It can be found in the Overworld and mined with a stone pickaxe or better.$(br)$(br)Height Range: Y -16 to 112$(br)Vein Size: 10$(br)Veins per Chunk: 16

pages.title: Tin Ore
pages.text: Found in stone layers. Drops 2 Raw Tin when mined. Fortune bonus applies.
